title: Cauldron Bubble w/o the Trouble? It’s Discord Halloween, Witches
summary: A cold wind whistles, a chill sets in. It’s Discord Halloween: Cauldron Chaos edition! We’ve got frights, we’ve got delights, and we’ve even got some spooky surprises up our sleeve…
body:
A cold wind whistles, a chill sets in. You, weary traveler, have grown tired and seek respite. Up ahead, a familiar sight: the Discord Shop. Shall we duck in for the night? What’s the worst that could happen…

Ok actually, hold up… this is a little sketchier than I expected. There’s a witch and a cat in here, and they’ve got a big bubbling vat of something that looks simply sinister. 

It’s Discord Halloween: Cauldron Chaos edition! Dropping today, October 1st. We’ve got frights, we’ve got delights, and we’ve even got some spooky surprises up our sleeve dropping later this month…
